# cpanel_email_account (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel email account and its current quota and disk usage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_account" "mailbox" {
  email = "terraform@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The complete email address on a domain owned by the cPanel account.

### Read-Only

- `disk_used_bytes` (Number) The disk space currently used by the email account, in bytes.
- `quota_mib` (Number) The configured disk quota in MiB, or `0` when unlimited.
